import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem sprint_development_0127 (q : ℚ) (n : ℤ) (hq : q ≥ n) : ⌈q⌉ ≥ n := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem sprint_development_0127 (q : ℚ) (n : ℤ) (hq : q ≥ n) : ⌈q⌉ ≥ n := by
  rw [Rat.ceil_def']
  have hnegq : -q ≤ -n := by linarith
  have hnegceil : -(-q.num / ↑q.den) ≤ -(-n) := by linarith
  linarith
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0127 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0127 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0127

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0127
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0127
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
